title: 2026 Topps Holiday #HE-22 Carson Benge RC Hidden Elf SP Variation New York Mets
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
2026 Topps Holiday #HE-22 Carson Benge rookie card (RC), New York Mets outfielder. Hidden Elf short-print (SP) variation: a small elf is hidden on the front, lower left by the Mets logo. Numbered HE-22 on the back instead of the base H number. Topps 75th anniversary logo.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
